meaning: Offline replay of retained captures; no current-runtime performance or profiler-overhead claim.

method.deltaWeights: Estimates only: each recorded delta is assigned to its right-end sample, including the first delay. A sample does not prove ownership throughout that interval.
method.context: Nearest known non-support caller for support/unknown WASM leaves is a separate contextual view, not exclusive cost; do not add it to the leaf budget.
method.limits: O3/V8 inlining stays in its containing body. Work ancestry excludes unrooted GC/VM samples even when they occurred during work. No confidence interval or unprofiled speed is inferred.
